parsedVerdict.reasoning: The use cases all handle orders and stock, but the same rules are repeated across files. The Order-to-OrderDto mapping is written out by hand in four use cases, even though PlaceOrderUseCase already has a private mapToDto helper that the others could share. UpdateOrderStatusUseCase hard-codes its own list of valid statuses instead of relying on OrderStatus and Order.transitionTo, so the domain's status rule is copied into the application layer. PlaceOrderUseCase checks order rules (lines must not be empty, quantities must be above zero) that probably belong to the Order entity; this part can't be confirmed because Order.ts wasn't provided. Because the module repeats rules that should live in one place, it fails the rubric.
